meta.description: Standalone evaluation of an existing PDB directory with Proteina-Complexa. Use when the user wants to evaluate PDB files, re-fold these designs, compute interface pAE, compute i_pLDDT for a folder, run AF2/RF3/ESMFold on designs, score binder candidates, designability of folder, scRMSD for designs, motif RMSD for PDBs, complexa analysis, evaluate from pdb dir, or to score third-party outputs (BindCraft, AlphaProteo, RFdiffusion, hand-curated decoys).

scientific_integrity.detail: Uses documented metrics from Complexa; no fabricated identifiers or results

practice_boundaries.detail: Computational evaluation tool with no medical claims

methodological_ground.detail: Appropriate refold validation methodology; metrics scientifically sound

code_usability.detail: Bash commands syntactically correct; Python snippet for ligand rename valid

functional_suitability.note: Complete 6-step workflow; handles 4 design types with correct config routing

reliability.note: Preflight validation, dryrun mode, troubleshooting table; lacks retry logic

performance_context.note: SKILL.md is 222 lines, acceptable with 1 reference file

agent_usability.note: Clear 6-step structure, design type table, common overrides list

human_usability.note: Good section headers, config comparison table helpful

security.note: Environment variables for paths; missing explicit input validation

maintainability.note: Good modularity with reference file; version-pinned configs

agent_specific.note: Good trigger precision; uses AskUserQuestion; composes with complexa-setup; deterministic via run_name; could improve progressive disclosure and escape hatches

recommendations.title: Add explicit input validation
recommendations.problem: No validation that pdb_dir exists or contains valid PDB files before launching evaluation. Security scored 11/12.
recommendations.root_cause: Relies on complexa CLI to catch invalid paths at runtime.
recommendations.fix: Add Step 1.5: validate pdb_dir exists, contains .pdb files, files are readable. Prevents cryptic errors mid-evaluation.

recommendations.title: Improve escape hatch guidance
recommendations.problem: Agent-Specific 8.5 scored lower; no explicit out-of-scope guidance for non-evaluation requests. Score: 13/20 for agent_specific.
